answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 29806 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: Due to a mistake i made in the tashahud position i kept reading the following: Attahiyyatu lillahi wassalawatu wattayyibat, assalamu AAalayka ayyuhan-nabiyyu warahmatul-lahi wabarakatuh wattayyibat, assalamu AAalayna waAAala AAibadil-lahis-saliheen. Ash-hadu an la ilaha illal-lah, wa-ashhadu anna Muhammadan AAabduhu warasooluh. Will all those salah i read with this wording be valid Question: Due to a mistake i made in the tashahud position i kept reading the following: Attahiyyatu lillahi wassalawatu wattayyibat, assalamu AAalayka ayyuhan-nabiyyu warahmatul-lahi wabarakatuh wattayyibat, assalamu AAalayna waAAala AAibadil-lahis-saliheen. Ash-hadu an la ilaha illal-lah, wa-ashhadu anna Muhammadan AAabduhu warasooluh. Will all those salah i read with this wording be valid Answer ID: 29806 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 378/H=108/th=1432) Your salah was valid, i.e. now you are not asked to re-offer those salah. However, it is wajib to memorise and read the whole tashahhud correctly. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
